Sikh dharm ke pratham guru guru nanak dev ji ke 557ven prakash parv ke avsar par patna siti sthit takht shri harimandir sahib men shraddha aur bhakti ka adbhut najara dekhne ko mil raha hai. prakash parv ko lekar pura gurudvara aakarshak roshni aur rang-birangi laiting se sajaya gaya hai.
